usedFor: Once Recall.ai finishes a meeting transcript, the agreed follow-up goes onto Google Calendar as a new event.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transcript Completed” in Recall.ai, then “Create Calendar Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: “Create Calendar Event” takes a time, duration, attendees and details, so the follow-up meeting is fully set.

watchOut: “New Webhook Event” is pushed for each recording or transcript status, so one call could add several calendar events.
